_comment: Test scenario for LAMBDA. Two queries: the newest 50 location_update items (one layer per source: TrackLocation, ankle_bracelet, gps_location; drawn from their own location.point) and the newest 50 image items, shown together in a layer named "image". recent_days, limit and layer are read by hl/items.py and not sent to HL API (limit is capped at 100). No location entities exist on LAMBDA, so the Location layer stays empty.
